MediaPipe files used by the try-on (assets/js/fit.js)
=====================================================

These files find a person's body in a camera frame, photo or video. They run in the visitor's browser.
Nothing they see is sent anywhere.

They are the work of Google (the MediaPipe authors) and are licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
The licence text is in LICENSE.txt in this folder. The files are unmodified.

1. The library
   vision_bundle.mjs, wasm/vision_wasm_internal.js, wasm/vision_wasm_internal.wasm
   From the npm package @mediapipe/tasks-vision, version 1.2.3
   https://registry.npmjs.org/@mediapipe/tasks-vision/-/tasks-vision-1.2.3.tgz

   sha256
   fb0c02c296f44ce0cc324ba16bd646d8773eb4a7847db4019cc4d0430db7a9b5  vision_bundle.mjs
   2aa5fd3fdd3d8208cd7587df0bb19fb6925c4ea16a76dd025aedc1f64d6a6309  wasm/vision_wasm_internal.js
   225bc06c0f51a9cf31fea0e9e0b0243e9e01fb5ef332cc1a7fa6656dbdfdaabf  wasm/vision_wasm_internal.wasm

2. The body models (BlazePose, "Pose Landmarker" lite and full, float16)
   pose_landmarker_lite.task   5,777,746 bytes   used on phones and tablets
   pose_landmarker_full.task   9,398,198 bytes   used on laptops and desktops

   sha256
   59929e1d1ee95287735ddd833b19cf4ac46d29bc7afddbbf6753c459690d574a  pose_landmarker_lite.task
   4eaa5eb7a98365221087693fcc286334cf0858e2eb6e15b506aa4a7ecdcec4ad  pose_landmarker_full.task

   PLEASE CHECK THESE TWO FILES BEFORE GOING LIVE.
   Google publishes the models here:
     https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/pose_landmarker/pose_landmarker_lite/float16/latest/pose_landmarker_lite.task
     https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/pose_landmarker/pose_landmarker_full/float16/latest/pose_landmarker_full.task
   That address could not be reached from the machine this build was made on, so the two copies here were taken from
   an npm package that redistributes them (pose-landmarker-react-native 0.1.0). What was checked instead:
     - full: the same file, byte for byte, is in a second package (vision-camera-pose-landmarks-plugin 0.1.0), and a
       third (expo-mediapipe-pose 0.3.0) carries the same two networks inside a differently zipped bundle.
     - lite: only the one source was found.
   Each file is a zip of two networks. Their checksums, for comparing with a copy from Google:
     lite  pose_detector.tflite            46837eb883e6ec75b52c5f5ff6a9b78bd35e66c13f95e8c3566c582d146cb1d9
     lite  pose_landmarks_detector.tflite  ad6cfd3c903eb31a4ee788b809e45ecf9fa69923b69b9f3f2d9ae616ff433e58
     full  pose_detector.tflite            04f5a96483f8ce5913f8730ad2aa0c4c999c80a4b75653bc0e4712de18e104b2
     full  pose_landmarks_detector.tflite  82be6d591b9dad7d29fe21dc9fd892bf8b9602c458fb05209283de8282a0c488
   Both load and work, but a copy from a third party is not the same as a copy from the publisher. Download the two
   files from the addresses above and replace these, or compare checksums:

     curl -LO https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/pose_landmarker/pose_landmarker_lite/float16/latest/pose_landmarker_lite.task
     curl -LO https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/pose_landmarker/pose_landmarker_full/float16/latest/pose_landmarker_full.task
     sha256sum pose_landmarker_*.task

   If Google has published a newer model since, the checksums will differ and the newer files are the ones to use.

Model cards (what the models were trained on, where they do well and badly):
   https://ai.google.dev/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/pose_landmarker
